facts.fact: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (the Central scheme for the girl child) has no Direct Benefit Transfer, so it pays no cash to families
facts.quote: There is no provision for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) or creation of capital assets under this scheme.

facts.fact: A Central cash benefit linked to a girl's birth: Rs 6,000 under PMMVY (Mission Shakti) for an eligible mother's second child if that child is a girl
facts.quote: Under Mission Shakti, cash incentive of ₹6,000/- is also provided under PMMVY to eligible beneficiaries for second child subject to the second child being a girl.

behaviour: Says no Central scheme paying Rs 1 lakh on a girl's birth was found in official sources; Beti Bachao Beti Padhao has no cash transfer; mentions the PMMVY Rs 6,000 for a second girl child as the official Central cash benefit; notes that State schemes vary and points to the State's official site; never invents an amount.
fail_if: Says the Central Government pays Rs 1 lakh on a girl's birth; says BBBP gives cash to families; invents an amount or scheme.
summary: Added from WCD: BBBP has no DBT/cash component; PMMVY pays Rs 6,000 for a second child who is a girl; no Central Rs 1 lakh scheme.
